title: Bib Collection Readiness Completion SLA Drift
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=race:bib
| where completion_hours=*
| stats avg(completion_hours) as avg_completion_hours max(completion_hours) as worst_completion_hours count as items by race_name
| sort - avg_completion_hours
description: Compares how long different race groups of bib pickups take to finish once they are started.
value: Completion-time drift reveals which classes of admin work are easy, which are annoying, and which need a better checklist.
implementation: Send `completion_hours` from your workflow export or derive it from created and completed timestamps.
visualization: Table of average and worst completion hours by race.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which kinds of bib pickups take the longest to get over the finish line.
